description: This file defines a plugin for the openclaw framework, specifically implementing the Z.AI provider with functions for authentication, model resolution, and provider registration.

methods.name: resolveGlm5ForwardCompatModel
methods.description: Resolves a model with glm-5 prefix, returning a normalized ProviderRuntimeModel or undefined.

methods.name: resolveZaiDefaultModel
methods.description: Returns the default model string, optionally overridden by a provided modelId.

methods.name: promptForZaiEndpoint
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a Z.AI endpoint from predefined options.

methods.name: runZaiApiKeyAuth
methods.description: Performs API key authentication for Z.AI, returning profiles, config patch, and default model.

methods.name: runZaiApiKeyAuthNonInteractive
methods.description: Performs non-interactive API key authentication for Z.AI, updating profiles and configuration.

methods.name: buildZaiApiKeyMethod
methods.description: Constructs a ProviderAuthMethod object for Z.AI API key authentication with specified parameters.
